dyn.contract.notice_number.canonical_definition: The publisher's contract notice identifier as published in contracts[0].id (e.g. CN4280221). It identifies the notice within the publisher's system; it is not a supplier key, ABN or ACN. It is not unique per release: an amendment release (tag 'contractAmendment') restates the original notice id, so the contract role key contracts[0].id collides across the original and amendment releases and the amendment release is not distinguishable by the contract key alone. The engine's named-role identity may repeat across records, so this is a bounded identity limitation, not an overwrite.

dyn.contract.signed_at.canonical_definition: The calendar date on which the contract was signed as stated in the notice (contracts[0].dateSigned). The source states a time of day, but this concept is a date and the time is not preserved; it is not the contract start date, the notice publication date, or the business's registration date.

dyn.contract.start_date.canonical_definition: The first day of the contract period stated in the notice (contracts[0].period.startDate). The source states a full timestamp whose time component is not constant across rows (e.g. 14:00Z on some rows, 13:00Z on others), so no fixed local-midnight convention can be assumed. The parse_date transform truncates the time, so the emitted value is the UTC date component of the stated timestamp; the local contract day may differ by one. It is not the release publication date and not the moment the notice was observed.

dyn.contract.end_date.canonical_definition: The last day of the contract period stated in the notice (contracts[0].period.endDate), i.e. the planned end of this contract's term. The source states a full timestamp whose time component is not constant across rows (e.g. 13:00Z observed), so no fixed local-midnight convention can be assumed. The parse_date transform truncates the time, so the emitted value is the UTC date component of the stated timestamp; the local contract day may differ by one. It is not a licence expiry and not a business's cessation.

dyn.contract.description.canonical_definition: The scope of work as the procuring entity described it in the notice (contracts[0].description), e.g. 'Stakeholder Engagement and Consultation Services'. It is source-stated activity text and describes this procurement, not the supplier's company-wide industry or sector.

dyn.contract.value.canonical_definition: The total maximum value of the contract over its life as reported in the notice (contracts[0].value.amount), qualified by the ISO 4217 currency in contracts[0].value.currency. It is not annual expenditure, not revenue or business income, and the contract term is captured by dyn.contract.start_date and dyn.contract.end_date on this same entity.

dyn.contract.status.canonical_definition: The status of the contract as reported in the notice at extraction time (contracts[0].status), expressed with the OCDS contract status codelist and 'unknown' for anything not published. Only 'active' is observed in this snapshot; the other values are codelist-derived, not observed. It reflects the notice data, is not a guarantee of the contract's current status, and is not the supplier's registration status.

dyn.contract.item_classification_code.canonical_definition: The classification code of a contracted item as published (contracts[0].items[0].classification.id), always paired with the publisher's scheme (contracts[0].items[0].classification.scheme, here UNSPSC). The code describes the goods or services bought under this contract, not the supplier's company-wide industry. Only the first item of a contract is read at this grain; additional items are not captured.

dyn.contract.procurement_method.canonical_definition: How the contract was let as reported in the notice (tender.procurementMethod), expressed with the OCDS procurement method codelist and 'unknown' if not published. It describes the procurement process only and says nothing about contract size, supplier capability or the notice population. On an amendment release the value is as restated in that release and may not differ from the original.

dyn.contract.limited_tender_exempt.canonical_definition: Whether the notice marks the limited tender as exempt (tender.limitedTenderExempt), published as 1 or 0 and mapped to true/false; a blank value is 'unknown', never false. Both 'true' (from raw '1') and 'false' (from raw '0') are observed in this snapshot; 'unknown' is codelist-derived, not observed. It records a stated procurement exemption, not a judgement about whether the exemption was justified.

It is not unique per release: an amendment release (tag 'contractAmendment') restates the original notice id, so the contract role key contracts[0].id collides across the original and amendment releases and the amendment release is not distinguishable by the contract key alone. The engine's named-role identity may repeat across records, so this is a bounded identity limitation, not an overwrite.

dyn.contract.signed_at.canonical_definition: The calendar date on which the contract was signed as stated in the notice (contracts[0].dateSigned). The source states a time of day, but this concept is a date and the time is not preserved; it is not the contract start date, the notice publication date, or the business's registration date.

dyn.contract.start_date.canonical_definition: The first day of the contract period stated in the notice (contracts[0].period.startDate). The source states a full timestamp whose time component is not constant across rows (e.g. 14:00Z on some rows, 13:00Z on others), so no fixed local-midnight convention can be assumed. The parse_date transform truncates the time, so the emitted value is the UTC date component of the stated timestamp; the local contract day may differ by one. It is not the release publication date and not the moment the notice was observed.

dyn.contract.end_date.canonical_definition: The last day of the contract period stated in the notice (contracts[0].period.endDate), i.e. the planned end of this contract's term. The source states a full timestamp whose time component is not constant across rows (e.g. 13:00Z observed), so no fixed local-midnight convention can be assumed. The parse_date transform truncates the time, so the emitted value is the UTC date component of the stated timestamp; the local contract day may differ by one. It is not a licence expiry and not a business's cessation.

dyn.contract.description.canonical_definition: The scope of work as the procuring entity described it in the notice (contracts[0].description), e.g. 'Stakeholder Engagement and Consultation Services'. It is source-stated activity text and describes this procurement, not the supplier's company-wide industry or sector.

dyn.contract.value.canonical_definition: The total maximum value of the contract over its life as reported in the notice (contracts[0].value.amount), qualified by the ISO 4217 currency in contracts[0].value.currency. It is not annual expenditure, not revenue or business income, and the contract term is captured by dyn.contract.start_date and dyn.contract.end_date on this same entity.

dyn.contract.status.canonical_definition: The status of the contract as reported in the notice at extraction time (contracts[0].status), expressed with the OCDS contract status codelist and 'unknown' for anything not published. Only 'active' is observed in this snapshot; the other values are codelist-derived, not observed. It reflects the notice data, is not a guarantee of the contract's current status, and is not the supplier's registration status.

It is not the release publication date and not the moment the notice was observed.

dyn.contract.end_date.canonical_definition: The last day of the contract period stated in the notice (contracts[0].period.endDate), i.e. the planned end of this contract's term. The source states a full timestamp whose time component is not constant across rows (e.g. 13:00Z observed), so no fixed local-midnight convention can be assumed. The parse_date transform truncates the time, so the emitted value is the UTC date component of the stated timestamp; the local contract day may differ by one. It is not a licence expiry and not a business's cessation.

dyn.contract.description.canonical_definition: The scope of work as the procuring entity described it in the notice (contracts[0].description), e.g. 'Stakeholder Engagement and Consultation Services'. It is source-stated activity text and describes this procurement, not the supplier's company-wide industry or sector.

dyn.contract.value.canonical_definition: The total maximum value of the contract over its life as reported in the notice (contracts[0].value.amount), qualified by the ISO 4217 currency in contracts[0].value.currency. It is not annual expenditure, not revenue or business income, and the contract term is captured by dyn.contract.start_date and dyn.contract.end_date on this same entity.

dyn.contract.status.canonical_definition: The status of the contract as reported in the notice at extraction time (contracts[0].status), expressed with the OCDS contract status codelist and 'unknown' for anything not published. Only 'active' is observed in this snapshot; the other values are codelist-derived, not observed. It reflects the notice data, is not a guarantee of the contract's current status, and is not the supplier's registration status.

dyn.contract.item_classification_code.canonical_definition: The classification code of a contracted item as published (contracts[0].items[0].classification.id), always paired with the publisher's scheme (contracts[0].items[0].classification.scheme, here UNSPSC). The code describes the goods or services bought under this contract, not the supplier's company-wide industry. Only the first item of a contract is read at this grain; additional items are not captured.

dyn.contract.procurement_method.canonical_definition: How the contract was let as reported in the notice (tender.procurementMethod), expressed with the OCDS procurement method codelist and 'unknown' if not published. It describes the procurement process only and says nothing about contract size, supplier capability or the notice population. On an amendment release the value is as restated in that release and may not differ from the original.

dyn.contract.limited_tender_exempt.canonical_definition: Whether the notice marks the limited tender as exempt (tender.limitedTenderExempt), published as 1 or 0 and mapped to true/false; a blank value is 'unknown', never false. Both 'true' (from raw '1') and 'false' (from raw '0') are observed in this snapshot; 'unknown' is codelist-derived, not observed. It records a stated procurement exemption, not a judgement about whether the exemption was justified.

dyn.grant_programme.code.canonical_definition: The short code the publisher prefixes to the programme label in the combined grant_list field (e.g. L, C), extracted by regex from the text before the first comma. Programme classification code, not a company-wide attribute. The extraction is unguarded: no transform in the available allowlist can check that the label after the comma equals the grant field, so a mismatched grant_list/grant pair would silently yield a wrong code. The value is therefore unverified publisher-prefix evidence, not a verified programme key, and is emitted at reduced confidence.

dyn.grant_programme.code.canonical_definition: The short code the publisher prefixes to the programme label in the combined grant_list field (e.g. L, C), extracted by regex from the text before the first comma. Programme classification code, not a company-wide attribute. The extraction is unguarded: no transform in the available allowlist can check that the label after the comma equals the grant field, so a mismatched grant_list/grant pair would silently yield a wrong code. The value is therefore unverified publisher-prefix evidence, not a verified programme key, and is emitted at reduced confidence.

The label is not a canonical programme key: typographic variants (ASCII vs curly apostrophe, hyphen vs en dash) are not normalised, so the same programme can appear under more than one label and therefore as more than one programme entity.

dyn.grant_programme.code.canonical_definition: The short code the publisher prefixes to the programme label in the combined grant_list field (e.g. L, C), extracted by regex from the text before the first comma. Programme classification code, not a company-wide attribute. The extraction is unguarded: no transform in the available allowlist can check that the label after the comma equals the grant field, so a mismatched grant_list/grant pair would silently yield a wrong code. The value is therefore unverified publisher-prefix evidence, not a verified programme key, and is emitted at reduced confidence.

dyn.grant_programme.name.canonical_definition: The published name of the grant programme or scheme under which awards are made, in the funding body's wording, kept verbatim. No suffix is stripped and no ward/locality meaning is asserted, because the source does not state that a ' - <suffix>' component is a delivery location rather than a distinct sub-programme. The label is not a canonical programme key: typographic variants (ASCII vs curly apostrophe, hyphen vs en dash) are not normalised, so the same programme can appear under more than one label and therefore as more than one programme entity.

dyn.grant_programme.code.canonical_definition: The short code the publisher prefixes to the programme label in the combined grant_list field (e.g. L, C), extracted by regex from the text before the first comma. Programme classification code, not a company-wide attribute. The extraction is unguarded: no transform in the available allowlist can check that the label after the comma equals the grant field, so a mismatched grant_list/grant pair would silently yield a wrong code. The value is therefore unverified publisher-prefix evidence, not a verified programme key, and is emitted at reduced confidence.

dyn.grant_programme.group.canonical_definition: The broader programme group or category the publisher assigns to the grant programme (e.g. Creative and history grants, Community grants), in the publisher's wording.

Programme classification code, not a company-wide attribute. The extraction is unguarded: no transform in the available allowlist can check that the label after the comma equals the grant field, so a mismatched grant_list/grant pair would silently yield a wrong code. The value is therefore unverified publisher-prefix evidence, not a verified programme key, and is emitted at reduced confidence.

dyn.grant_programme.name.canonical_definition: The published name of the grant programme or scheme under which awards are made, in the funding body's wording, kept verbatim. No suffix is stripped and no ward/locality meaning is asserted, because the source does not state that a ' - <suffix>' component is a delivery location rather than a distinct sub-programme. The label is not a canonical programme key: typographic variants (ASCII vs curly apostrophe, hyphen vs en dash) are not normalised, so the same programme can appear under more than one label and therefore as more than one programme entity.

dyn.grant_programme.code.canonical_definition: The short code the publisher prefixes to the programme label in the combined grant_list field (e.g. L, C), extracted by regex from the text before the first comma. Programme classification code, not a company-wide attribute. The extraction is unguarded: no transform in the available allowlist can check that the label after the comma equals the grant field, so a mismatched grant_list/grant pair would silently yield a wrong code. The value is therefore unverified publisher-prefix evidence, not a verified programme key, and is emitted at reduced confidence.

dyn.grant_programme.group.canonical_definition: The broader programme group or category the publisher assigns to the grant programme (e.g. Creative and history grants, Community grants), in the publisher's wording.

dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.business.registered_business_name.canonical_definition: The registered business name of the operator as published by the NPI. This is a registered business name, which for individuals/partnerships is not a registered company legal name; it does not assert legal-name status or legal form. Blank in source is treated as missing (no claim emitted), not as an empty name.

entity.abn.canonical_definition: Australian Business Number. Has a checksum — validate it, do not just length-check.

dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.business.registered_business_name.canonical_definition: The registered business name of the operator as published by the NPI. This is a registered business name, which for individuals/partnerships is not a registered company legal name; it does not assert legal-name status or legal form. Blank in source is treated as missing (no claim emitted), not as an empty name.

entity.abn.canonical_definition: Australian Business Number. Has a checksum — validate it, do not just length-check.

dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this code; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_n.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this label; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.

dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_id.canonical_definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry. dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_n.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording. dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.

dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_id.canonical_definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). The domain may belong to the operator, a parent/group, or the facility itself (e.g. a group domain published against a differently named operator), so this is a facility-level published link and is not asserted to be the operator's own website.

dyn.business.registered_business_name.canonical_definition: The registered business name of the operator as published by the NPI. This is a registered business name, which for individuals/partnerships is not a registered company legal name; it does not assert legal-name status or legal form. Blank in source is treated as missing (no claim emitted), not as an empty name.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this code; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_n.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this label; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.

dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_id.canonical_definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). The domain may belong to the operator, a parent/group, or the facility itself (e.g. a group domain published against a differently named operator), so this is a facility-level published link and is not asserted to be the operator's own website.

dyn.business.registered_business_name.canonical_definition: The registered business name of the operator as published by the NPI. This is a registered business name, which for individuals/partnerships is not a registered company legal name; it does not assert legal-name status or legal form. Blank in source is treated as missing (no claim emitted), not as an empty name.

dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_id.canonical_definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.

dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_id.canonical_definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). The domain may belong to the operator, a parent/group, or the facility itself (e.g. a group domain published against a differently named operator), so this is a facility-level published link and is not asserted to be the operator's own website.

dyn.business.registered_business_name.canonical_definition: The registered business name of the operator as published by the NPI. This is a registered business name, which for individuals/partnerships is not a registered company legal name; it does not assert legal-name status or legal form. Blank in source is treated as missing (no claim emitted), not as an empty name.

entity.abn.canonical_definition: Australian Business Number. Has a checksum — validate it, do not just length-check.

entity.acn.canonical_definition: Australian Company Number. Also checksummed. The last 9 digits of an ABN are often the ACN, but not always.

dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this code; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_n.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this label; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.

dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_id.canonical_definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). The domain may belong to the operator, a parent/group, or the facility itself (e.g. a group domain published against a differently named operator), so this is a facility-level published link and is not asserted to be the operator's own website.

dyn.business.registered_business_name.canonical_definition: The registered business name of the operator as published by the NPI. This is a registered business name, which for individuals/partnerships is not a registered company legal name; it does not assert legal-name status or legal form. Blank in source is treated as missing (no claim emitted), not as an empty name.

entity.abn.canonical_definition: Australian Business Number. Has a checksum — validate it, do not just length-check.

entity.acn.canonical_definition: Australian Company Number. Also checksummed. The last 9 digits of an ABN are often the ACN, but not always.

dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry. dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_n.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording. dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). dyn.establishment.npi_facility_id.canonical_definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_facility_.canonical_definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.

dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.canonical_definition: The jurisdiction code under which the NPI registers the facility, as published. Usually an Australian state/territory code (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT), but the source reportedly also contains at least one non-state code ('COM'), so this is a free string rather than a closed enum; the raw code is preserved so the required qualifier on jurisdiction_facility_id is never dropped. Not guaranteed equal to dyn.establishment.state.

ext.establishment.geo.canonical_definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

dyn.establishment.street_address.canonical_definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office. The mapping applies trim and collapse_whitespace only; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 (non-breaking space) is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value.

dyn.establishment.suburb.canonical_definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.

dyn.establishment.state.canonical_definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The mapping uses a closed 8-code enum with no passthrough: a state value outside that set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced.

dyn.establishment.postcode.canonical_definition: The Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published. Observed values are 4-digit strings (e.g. '3169', '6155', '3300', '4428'). The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit validator; no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_c.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this code; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.primary_anzsic_class_n.canonical_definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording. The scheme qualifier records the ANZSIC edition assumed for this label; the source column does not state an edition, so the qualifier is an inference, not a publisher-stated fact.

dyn.establishment.main_activities.value: Milling of sugar cane to produce raw sugar
dyn.establishment.main_activities.canonical_definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.

dyn.establishment.first_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_year.canonical_definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.

dyn.establishment.report_count.canonical_definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_id.canonical_definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.

dyn.establishment.latest_report_url.canonical_definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the transform may normalise the value, so this is not asserted to be byte-for-byte verbatim). A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.

dyn.establishment.published_website.canonical_definition: The website the NPI publishes for the facility, as emitted by the website transform (a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host). The domain may belong to the operator, a parent/group, or the facility itself (e.g. a group domain published against a differently named operator), so this is a facility-level published link and is not asserted to be the operator's own website.
